Name: Archelaus
Summary: Archelaus was a son of Herod the Great who ruled Judea, Samaria, and Idumea after his father's death. Joseph, returning from Egypt, turned aside to Galilee when he heard Archelaus reigned in Judea.
KeyStory: One sentence in Matthew explains why Jesus grew up in Nazareth: Joseph feared Archelaus and settled in Galilee instead.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary; Herod the Great
LifeLesson: God guides His people through ordinary prudence as well as dreams. Joseph's detour to Nazareth fulfilled prophecy.
